{{Quote|Her name says all you need to know. The ''Lady Luck''{{'s}} fickle, but when she's smiling down on you, you're bound to win. She hasn't given up on me yet.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="TNEGtVaV" />}}
The '''''Lady Luck'''''&mdash;a [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]]&mdash;was the personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of gambler and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]/[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] hero [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. The ship was named after [[Ymile]], the girlfriend of [[Dominic Raynor]], who secretly helped Lando win [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] from Raynor, and whom Lando nicknamed his "Lady Luck" for her assistance.

==History==
[[File:Lady_luck-nar_shaddaa.png|thumb|left|The ''Lady Luck'' on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]|241x241px]]
Lando owned numerous starships throughout his long career, but the ''Lady Luck'' was the one that remained in his possession the longest. Calrissian obtained ''Lady Luck'' from an [[Orthellin royal mistress/Legends|Orthellin royal mistress]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

Lando lost the ''Lady Luck'' on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], after being forced to leave it there.<ref name="Jedi Search">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> He feared that it would be disassembled by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] forces, but when the [[Smugglers' Alliance]] came to Kessel to begin a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] mining operation, they found the ''Luck'' unharmed where Lando had left it. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] personally presented it to him when he returned to Kessel.<ref name="Champions of the Force">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref>

In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] when Lando was captured by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] gangster [[Reelo Baruk]], the ship was impounded in a [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] hangar bay, guarded by many of Baruk's thugs. With the help of [[Kyle Katarn]], Lando escaped from [[Reelo Baruk's hideout]], and the two prepared to escape the planet, but not before Baruk made one last ditch effort to stop the two [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] heroes. Utilizing an [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] cannon and a handful of thugs, Baruk attempted to damage the vessel beyond repair, though fortunately for the luxury starship, [[Kyle Katarn]] held off the attackers using one of ''Lady Luck''{{'s}} cannons. The ''Lady Luck'' escaped Baruk's compound on Nar Shaddaa and headed to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>

[[File:Lando-LadyLuck_SWGTCG-AoD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Lando stopped by stormtroopers after exiting the ''Lady Luck'']]
During the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], Lando went with [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ejagga Pakkpekatt|Pakkpekatt]] to investigate the [[Teljkon Vagabond]]. He and his crew attached ''Lady Luck'' to the Vagabond's hull after getting past its defenses. The group managed to uncover the secrets of the Vagabond.<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>

In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], Lando flew it to the [[Skip 1]] on the [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]], in search of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. However, after he was captured by [[Nandreeson]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] there presumed him to be dead and gutted the interior of the ship, taking whatever they could get. After Lando was rescued by Han, he returned to Skip 1 and salvaged what he could of the ''Lady Luck''{{'s}} former contents. Shortly after, he used it to transport injured smugglers to [[Wrea/Legends|Wrea]], when [[Kueller]] detonated a series of bombs that devastated the run.<ref name="The New Rebellion">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>

Lando continued to use the ''Luck'' during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and flew it during the [[Battle of Ebaq]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> During the climactic [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]], the advanced sensor systems of the ''Lady Luck'' proved invaluable, allowing Lando and his wife [[Tendra Risant Calrissian|Tendra Risant]] to relay important information to [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] forces.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

==Modifications==
[[File:Lady_Luck_schematics.png|thumb|right|180px|''Lady Luck'' [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]]]]
At the time, Lando's involvement with the mining operation known as [[Nomad City]] kept him from tinkering with the starship, but in the years since he repeatedly modified and upgraded ''Lady Luck''.

Lando initially planned to transform the ''Lady Luck'' into an advanced luxury cruiser. However, Calrissian's near-constant involvement with the New Republic forced him to convert the ''Lady Luck'' into a competent combat vehicle. At first glance, the fifty-meter-long starship appeared to be an unarmed pleasure [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]], but this placid exterior concealed five retractable [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and a small [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] turret. A pair of powerful Chempat-6 [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] generators provided moderate protection from enemy fire. ''Lady Luck''{{'s}} engines were housed in two long engine pods connected to the main hull. Although the starship's sublight and [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] speeds could not match those of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], the ''Lady Luck'' could still outrace nearly any other luxury vehicle in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

[[File:Lady_luck_bridge.jpg|thumb|left|221px|Bridge of the ''Lady Luck'']]
The ''Lady Luck''{{'s}} secondary systems truly set it apart. It had a highly sophisticated sensor system allowing Lando to detect, identify, and scan approaching vessels at great range. When ''Lady Luck'' was scanned by customs officials or enemy forces, the ship's transponder could be programmed with up to three separate false identities that include aliases, fake cargo manifests, and modified system specs. Lando frequently changed these identities, although he used the alias ''Stardream'' on more than one occasion. A [[Droid/Legends|droid]] brain aboard the starship could pilot it in emergencies and direct it towards a [[Beckon call/Legends|beckon call]] that Lando always kept on his belt; this feature proved especially helpful when Lando, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were forced to flee the mining city of [[Ilic]]. The starship also had concealed [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] compartments.

Although the ''Lady Luck'' was well-suited to combat, it was still a lavish luxury starship. An entire observation level included an exterior deck and numerous viewports. Lando's private suite and the five visitor cabins were decorated with rare art from around the galaxy. Conform-couches could be found throughout the starship, and the main deck contained a jet-stream meditation pool, and a small crystal garden.
